description: This file provides helper functions for managing account configurations, including listing, resolving, merging, and describing account snapshots within a channel context in a larger application.

methods.name: createAccountListHelpers
methods.description: Creates helper functions for listing and resolving account IDs based on channel configuration and options.

methods.name: listCombinedAccountIds
methods.description: Combines multiple account ID lists into a sorted array, including optional implicit and fallback IDs.

methods.name: resolveListedDefaultAccountId
methods.description: Determines the default account ID from a list of account IDs, considering configuration and fallback options.

methods.name: mergeAccountConfig
methods.description: Merges channel and account configurations, optionally omitting keys and merging nested objects.

methods.name: resolveMergedAccountConfig
methods.description: Resolves and merges account-specific configuration based on account ID and normalization.

methods.name: describeAccountSnapshot
methods.description: Creates a snapshot object describing an account, including ID, name, enabled status, and extra info.

methods.name: describeWebhookAccountSnapshot
methods.description: Creates a webhook-specific account snapshot, extending the general account snapshot with mode info.
